correctness.rationale: The transition on 512 board colour masks, nine positions and four directions has an explicit inverse, so no preperiods. Independently enumerated all 18,432 states: 24 cycles each of lengths 18,30,42,66,78,102; 72 each of lengths 70,74, totaling 288 cycles and 18,432 states. Independently checked that 72 translations/quarter rotations/reflections with colour complement commute with F, and temporal+group orbits of representatives [116,128,43,0,40,42,120,385] are pairwise disjoint, respectively of sizes 432,720,1008,1584,5040,5328,1872,2448, covering the entire finite state set. This is a genuine exhaustive finite proof, not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: A natural complete permutation-cycle classification of the smallest nondegenerate square torus, verifying every state rather than one celebrated seed. Eight symmetry types compress 288 distinct temporal cycles in a mathematically meaningful way.

final_claim: The reversible turn–flip–move Langton ant on the labelled 3x3 torus has exactly 18,432 periodic states, 288 primitive cycles, eight least periods 18,30,42,66,70,74,78,102, and one orbit-class per period under the 72-element translation/rotation/colour-complementing reflection group.
